definitions.explanation: A gathering of vendors selling goods, typically held periodically at a specific location. Can be a traditional open-air market or a special event.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝|あさ}{市|いち}→朝市：13008_asaichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought vegetables at the morning market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{第|だい}{一|いち}→第一：19377_daiichi⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蚤|のみ}の{市|いち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A flea market is held on the first Sunday of every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魚|さかな}{市|いち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大|おお}にぎわいだ。
examples.english: The year-end fish market is very crowded.

notes:
{市|いち} refers to a traditional market or fair, distinct from ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ which means "city."

COMMON TYPES OF MARKETS:
- ⟦{朝|あさ}{市|いち}→朝市：13008_asaichi⟧: morning market
- {夕|ゆう}{市|いち}: evening market
- {蚤|のみ}の{市|いち}: flea market
- {魚|さかな}{市|いち}: fish market
- {骨董|こっとう}{市|いち}: antique market
- ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧{市|いち}: handcraft market
- ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧{市|いち} / ⟦クリスマス→クリスマス：03839_kurisumasu⟧⟦マーケット→マーケット：00265_maaketto⟧: Christmas market

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦マーケット→マーケット：00265_maaketto⟧: market (loanword)
- ⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧: marketplace, market
- ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: market (economic sense)

USAGE:
Be careful not to confuse {市|いち} (market) with ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (city).
